stages.native:
WITH selected AS (
 SELECT * FROM public.warehouse_run_report_status
 [[WHERE dag_run_id = {{run_id}}]]
 ORDER BY recorded_at DESC, dag_run_id DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT x.label AS "대상", COALESCE(round(x.lag_s::numeric)::text,'확인 불가') AS "지연 (초)", COALESCE(round(s.stale_after_s::numeric)::text,'확인 불가') AS "임계값 (초)", CASE WHEN x.ord = 1 THEN '해당 없음' ELSE COALESCE(x.holds::text,'확인 불가') END AS "연속 보류 횟수" FROM (SELECT 1) seed LEFT JOIN selected s ON true
LEFT JOIN public.warehouse_run_report_domain_status od ON od.dag_run_id=s.dag_run_id AND od.domain='orders'
LEFT JOIN public.warehouse_run_report_domain_status sd ON sd.dag_run_id=s.dag_run_id AND sd.domain='subscriptions'
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (1,'주문 데이터',s.data_lag_s,NULL::integer), (2,'주문 도메인',od.lag_s,od.consecutive_holds), (3,'구독 도메인',sd.lag_s,sd.consecutive_holds)) x(ord,label,lag_s,holds)
ORDER BY x.ord

description: 지연과 임계값은 판정 기록 시각 기준이며 조회 시점에 재계산하지 않는다. 주문 데이터 지연에는 도메인 보류 횟수가 없다.
name: Lag vs Threshold (지연과 임계값)
